name: Oryx Desert Salt
description:
Oryx Desert Salt has a particularly unique origin tale, which begins in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. When Samantha Skyring, founder & CEO, decided to walk 7 days / 120 km / 75 miles through the Namib Desert in July 2000, having close encounters with the Oryx gazelle, she had no idea this experience would profoundly influence the creation of the global brand, Oryx Desert Salt.

The Oryx, a symbol of the Kalahari, truly honours the heritage of Oryx Desert Salt. Sourced sustainably from the vast Kalahari Desert in Southern Africa, the salt originates from an ancient underground lake fed by subterranean streams flowing through 250-million-year-old Dwyka rock strata, then laid to rest on a natural pan under the hot African sun. 100% sun-dried, harvested, unrefined & unprocessed, our salt contains the perfect natural balance of minerals and trace elements, allowing the body to absorb and utilise them for optimal functioning, vitality, and health.
